scope: Actual inspection of final v3 native renders, compared with the three principal reference photographs actually viewed by root. This is bounded exterior-model visual review, not a surveyed or complete historical-reconstruction claim; browser/map pixels are checked separately.

views.finding: 北端三列窗、深入口与上部阶梯塔冠完整；裙楼白檐没有横穿高基座正面。
楔形低楼和圆端、高低楼体连续立面及退台关系可见。
后部低体与高塔相连，后立面和屋面按明确估计范围表现；不代表背面照片验收。
东北窗轴连续，温度计杆位于实墙肋外，横撑与球部可辨，无虚构读数。

limits: 72m architectural endpoint and 13+7+2 layer allocation are author interpretations.
High-base quadrilateral versus documented rectangular upper plan remains unresolved.
Hidden rear/roof, detailed decorations and exact window counts remain estimates.
Old Wing On, street bridges, neighboring buildings, interiors and antenna excluded.
